verdict.rationale: Clerk's CLI docs say it helps set up OAuth providers for production, which points to configuration-driven provider setup. Its Enterprise SSO supports configurable SAML and OIDC connections to IdPs such as Azure AD, Okta, and Google Workspace. No evidence enumerates which social providers are supported or shows them enabled by toggling in the dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported social providers (e.g., Google, GitHub, Apple), documentation of no-code dashboard configuration for social login, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
